finalText:
Fixed. All 5 tests pass.

**Cause:** `src/services/pricing.js:22` (old) subtracted flat coupon `amount` from the already-converted total. But flat amounts are stored in USD (`src/models/coupon.js:7`), so a $10 coupon became €10 — an inflated discount at rate < 1, undersized at rate > 1. `$100` order in EUR gave `100*0.9 - 10 = 80` instead of `(100-10)*0.9 = 81`. USD orders unaffected (rate 1) — masked the bug.

**Fix:** apply coupon in USD, convert last. Extracted `applyCoupon(amountUsd, coupon)`. Percent path result unchanged (multiplication commutes with conversion), but now lives in the same base-currency space — no more mixed-space math.

Also added `Math.max(0, ...)` — coupon bigger than subtotal previously yielded a negative total. Not covered by tests; flagging since it was reachable via `src/routes/checkout.js:17`.
